in_sanskrit.name: Lacky
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God's Grace
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Lacky एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Lakshya' meaning 'goal' or 'target'. Lacky is a name that signifies the divine grace of God and the blessings bestowed upon an individual. It is believed that the name Lacky brings happiness, joy, and success in one's life.
